name: Intellivision
significance: Introduced the first 16-bit microprocessor architecture in a home console, birthed Utopia (widely considered the first city builder/RTS), and pioneered early voice synthesis.

editorialContent.overview: Mattel's sophisticated 16-bit processor challenger to Atari, offering advanced sports simulations and voice synthesis.
editorialContent.marketLegacy: Introduced the first 16-bit microprocessor architecture in a home console, birthed Utopia (widely considered the first city builder/RTS), and pioneered early voice synthesis.
editorialContent.controllerDesign: Dual numeric keypads with directional disc and side buttons
